QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_22

question.text: Hedge Funds are characteristic of HIGHER risk taking compared to other AIFs because:

answer.text: They use significant leverage at fund level

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.2.3, hedge funds' higher risk comes from significant fund-level leverage (obligation to pay back debt regardless of gains). The Trap: Other factors aren't the primary risk driver. Cross-Exam Context: Fundamental risk characterization. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Educate clients on the compounding of leverage + market risk in Cat III AIFs.
